description.zh:
服务端应用名称。

由字母、数字和下划线组成，不超过15个字符。
description.en:
The name of the server application.

The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores, and cannot exceed 15 characters in length.
The ID of the IoVCC project.

description.zh: 上行业务消息tag，方便应用服务器端对上行消息分类处理。多个tag通过英文逗号分隔。
description.en: The upstream business message tags, which help the application server classify and process upstream messages. Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

title.zh: 创建处理上行消息的服务端应用
title.en: Create a server application for processing upstream messages

descriptions.zh: > 根据名称、业务消息过滤标签、项目工程ID创建服务端应用。
descriptions.en: > Creates a server application based on the name, business message filtering tags, and project ID.
